verdict.rationale: The only export-related items are question-form support article titles, which cannot establish capability. No affirmative evidence shows Eqvista exporting the complete cap table or full transaction history to Excel or CSV. The documented downloadable PDF covers round-modeling analysis, a different feature in a non-open format. The generic mention of 'cap-table reports' names no export format and says nothing about transaction history.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can export my complete cap table and full transaction history to open formats (Excel/CSV) at any time — my ownership data is never held hostage
